text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Since then, the ghosts have steadily grown, and 
they were finally about to greet the first day of the reopening.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれからお化けたちは着実に成長を遂げ、
いよいよリニューアル開館の初日を迎えようとしていた。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Haa... It's finally here... I'm getting nervous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
いよいよだね……
緊張するな……

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Um, yeah... I wonder if I can do it well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだね……
うまくできるかな……

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: I won't move, I won't move...
text_block_list.orig_text:
動かない、
オレサマは、
動かない……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Guide the customers smoothly to the right... 
Guide the customers smoothly to the right...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客をうまく誘導して右へ……
お客をうまく誘導して右へ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Oh! What are you so nervous about? You've practiced so much, so you'll be fine! Believe in yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう！
　何緊張してるんですか！
あれだけ練習してきたんだから大丈夫です！
自分を信じましょう！

text_block_list.name: レイ
text_block_list.text: 私はかよわい女幽霊……
text_block_list.orig_text: 私はかよわい女幽霊……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Miss Rei, please calm down! Everything will be alright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイ様も落ち着いてください！
　大丈夫ですから！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's right! Practice doesn't betray you, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうッスよ！
　練習は自分を裏切らないッス！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: W-Why can Matsuri be so confident like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしてマツリは
そんなに自信満々でいられるんだい？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
I am a fan of hero shows, pal! Even though it's different,
it's fun to be on the performing side!
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分はヒーローショーのファンッスからね！
モノは違えど、
演じる側になれるのは
なんか楽しいんス！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it! It's natural to feel nervous! 
But first, please try to enjoy yourself! 
To entertain the customers, you have to start with yourself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
それです！
　緊張するのは仕方ありません！
でもまずは自分が楽しもうとしてください！
お客さんを楽しませるには
まず自分からですよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: But in this case, I have to make them scared, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもこの場合は
怖がらせる、
ッスよね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I don't care about the details!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 細かいことはいいんです！！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: You seem lively since the morning, young lady.
text_block_list.orig_text:
朝から威勢がいいなぁ、
嬢ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Ghost Father. Do you need something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴーストファーザーさん。
何か用ですか？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: I'm just checking on them. How's it going? It's a little better...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとあいつらの様子を見にな。
どうだ？
　少しはマシに……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
I can't see that you've changed. 
I've heard that you've become able to endure a little bit of screaming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なったようには見えねぇな。
多少は悲鳴を食えるようになったとは聞いてるが。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Even though I'm still a cast member at the haunted house, I've been steadily growing. I've reached a level where I'm not embarrassed to be in front of the customers. I'll show you what I'm capable of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれでもお化け屋敷のキャストとしては
着実に成長してますよ。
お客さんの前に出しても恥ずかしくないレベルにはなりました。
あなたのことを見返してやりますよ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's gonna be fun. 
Well, Miss Rei, please bring in lots of customers for us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃあ楽しみだな。
まぁ
せいぜいたくさんの客を呼び込んでくれや。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, even without being told.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
言われなくても。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on! Don't just stand there, let's open the shop already! Kishi-san, please go around the town and advertise vigorously!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら！
　いつまでも固まってないで開店しますよ！
騎士さんは町を回ってじゃんじゃん宣伝してきてくださいね！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Let's entertain the customers together, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text: みんなでお客さんを楽しませましょう！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
It's surprisingly a well-made haunted house, huh? 
The receptionist lady earlier was also really into it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
意外としっかりしたお化け屋敷だね。
さっきの受付のお姉さんも凝ってたし。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: S-So, that's right...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうね……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to be so scared.
I've heard that this place isn't that scary.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに怖がらなくても大丈夫だよ。
ここはそんなに怖くないって話だから。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: But, darkness is still scary after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
暗いのはやっぱり怖いわ……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the ground beneath your feet bright enough? 
If you're scared, just look down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんと足元は明るいじゃないか。
怖ければ下向いてればいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Well, that's just wasteful, isn't it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それはそれでもったいないじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then I'll hold your hand.
Come on, let's move forward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら、
手を繋いであげるから。
ほら、
先へ進もう。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Ah! Another customer, I presume?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～！
　またお客さんッスか～！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Welcome! Come play with us~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃ～い！
　オイラたちと
あそぼ～！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Wha- Who are these kids?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何この子たち？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Hey, sis! If you're free, why don't you play with us? 
What do you think would be a fun game to play?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おねえさん、
ヒマなら自分たちと遊ぶッスよ！
何して遊ぶのがいいッスかね～

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, if that's the case,
I'll adjust to your pace, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えっと、
それならあなたたちに合わせるわよ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
We're just so hungry, aren't we~
So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分たち
ちょうどお腹空いてるんスよね～
だから～……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Can you be my snack?
text_block_list.orig_text: おやつになってもらってもいいッスか？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Delicious-looking snacks, here I go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしそうなおやつ、
いただきま～す！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: へ？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOOH
text_block_list.orig_text: グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's cute how you get scared so easily like this.
Hey, don't go ahead alone, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
これくらいで怖がっちゃってかわいいなー
おーい、
一人で先に行かないでよー

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Nom nom... Scream... Delicious...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あむあむ……
悲鳴……おいしい……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that's great, isn't it? 
But Victor, your howling is getting better and better. 
Is it because you're growing by eating screams?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
よかったッスね。
それにしてもビクターさん、
吠えるのどんどんうまくなってるッスね。
悲鳴を食べて成長してるってことなんスかね？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's all thanks to Matsuri being with me~ 
Thank you~ Let's keep doing our best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと
マツリちゃんが一緒に居てくれるおかげだよ～
ありがと～
もっとがんばろうね～

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's right! Our battle has only just begun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうッスね！
　自分たちの戦いは
まだ始まったばっかッス！

text_block_list.name: 女性１
text_block_list.text:
はぁ……
びっくりした～
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
びっくりした～

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hey now, it's dangerous to run, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらこら、
走ると危ないよ。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんなさい。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think you were such a scaredy-cat. 
Your frightened expression is cute though. 
You don't have to force yourself, just follow after me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君がこんなに怖がりだとは思わなかったよ。
怖がる姿もかわいいけどね。
無理しなくていいから
僕のあとについてきな。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Ugh, I really hope you can spare me from being scared anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
はぁ～
もう怖いのは勘弁してほしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is there something troubling you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おやおや、
何かお困りかい？

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: EEK!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ひっ！？

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Another incredibly adorable one has appeared, huh? 
The same trick won't work this time, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
またずいぶんとかわいらしいのが出てきたね。
さっきと同じ手は通じないよ？

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what you're talking about. 
I'm just here as a guide.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんのことを言っているのか分からないな。
オレはここで水先案内人をしてるだけだからね。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
There are two paths ahead. 
One leads to light, the other to hell. 
Which one is better?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この先には二つの道がある。
片方は光へ続く道、
もう一つは地獄へ続く道。
どっちがいい？

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: The path continues towards the light!
text_block_list.orig_text: 光へ続く道！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Since we're already here,
let's go to the scary-looking place.
text_block_list.orig_text: せっかくだから怖そうな方に行こうよ。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: No! I don't want to be surprised anymore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや！
　もうびっくりしたくない！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I see, I see. In that case, it's over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
そうかいそうかい。
それならあっちだよ。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Over there, got it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっちね、
分かったわ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Who dares disturb my slumber?!
text_block_list.orig_text: オレサマの眠りを妨げるのは誰だぁぁああ！！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaahhhhh!?
text_block_list.orig_text: うわぁあぁあああ！？

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You fell for it!
There's no way I'd tell you the true path so easily!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは！
　ひっかかってやんの！
そんな素直に本当の道教えるわけないじゃん！！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: This is terrible...
text_block_list.orig_text: ひどい……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: This is just part of the job, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text: これが仕事なもんでね。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
then this must be the path that leads to light...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら
こっちが光へ続く道なのね……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so scared, it's okay. 
Look, this time I'll go first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに怖がらなくても大丈夫だよ。
ほら、
今度は僕が先に行くから。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Please take care!
text_block_list.orig_text: お気をつけてー

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Phew, somehow we managed to succeed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
なんとか成功したな。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ah, I missed out on devouring that scream just now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
今悲鳴食い損ねちまった！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text:
It's true! I forgot! 
Well, next, next! We can do it, Miss Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとだ！
　忘れてた！
まぁ次だ次！
　オレサマたちなら
できる！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Is that so!
text_block_list.orig_text: だな！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really want to go outside soon...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
早く外に出たいわ……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, there's no need to be so scared, you know.
They were just adorable little ghosts, weren't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは、
そんなに怖がることないだろ。
かわいらしいお化けたちだったじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if you say that, 
it's natural to be surprised, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなこと言われても
ビックリするものはするんだから仕方ないじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
Then, hide behind me.
If you do that, you should be fine, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、僕の後ろに隠れてなよ。
それなら平気だろ？

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Ah... Where did that person go, leaving me behind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
あの人は
私を置いてどこに行ってしまったんだろう……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Oh, the next trap, huh? Let's go and check it out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
次の仕掛けか。
行ってみよう。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've been waiting here for so long... 
Why hasn't that person come yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずっとここで待っているというのに……
あの人はどうして……

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Oh, this time it's a woman...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
今度は女の人……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Wow, I didn't know there was something like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
こういうのもあるんだね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you finally came.
I've been waiting for you all this time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
やっと来てくれたんだ。
ずっと待っていたんだよ……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: It's a case of mistaken identity. There's no way I could forget meeting a beautiful girl like you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人違いだよ。
君みたいなきれいな子と知り合ってたら
忘れるわけないもん。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you saying while I'm here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
私が居るのに何言ってるのよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Who... those people... 
You always... seem to enjoy yourself with lots of women...
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰……
その人たち……
あなたはいつもそう……
たくさんの女の人と楽しそうに……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's great. It really sets the mood.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
いいね。
雰囲気出てるよ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: You always... leave me behind and only play with other people... Even I want to play together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたはいつもそう……
私を置いて他の人とばかり……
私だって一緒に遊びたいのに……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait a minute. Who are those people...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　待てよ？
その人、
たち……？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting!
text_block_list.orig_text: お待たせ！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Wow!?
text_block_list.orig_text: わあっ！？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Why are you scared? We came all the way here together, didn't we? Look, let's play together! It's fun when everyone plays together! Forever and ever, forever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで怖がるの？
　ここまで一緒に来たじゃないか！
ほら、
キミたちも遊ぼう！
　みんなで遊べば楽しいよ！
ず～～っと、
永遠に、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaaaaaahhh!! What is this!? 
Don't come near! Don't come over hereeee!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わあぁあああああ！！
　なんだこれ！？
くるな！
　こっちにくるなぁあああ！！

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, wait!! Don't leave me behind!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ちょ、ちょっと！！
　置いてかないでよー！！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Amph, amph... Huh? 
This scream, it tastes different somehow... 
It's tastier than what I ate at the graveyard...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あむあむ……
あれ？
この悲鳴、
なんだか味が違う……
お墓で食べたのより、
おいしい……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
Well, as long as it's delicious, it's all good, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうなのか……？
まぁ、
おいしいならいいんじゃないかな？

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hah...
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text:
Don't leave me behind anymore.
But... hehe, I found it amusing to see you scared,
so I'll forgive you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もぅ、
置いてかないでよ。
けど……
ふふっ、
怖がるあなたが面白かったから許してあげる。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's a haunted house that looks interesting. 
Won't you come in?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
なんか面白そうなお化け屋敷があるよ。
入ってみない？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Huh? But this isn't the popular haunted house, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　でも
人気のお化け屋敷はここじゃないよ？

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Isn't it okay to have a little fun? Right? Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとくらいいいじゃん！
　ね？　行こう！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Ho, looks like we're off to a good start with the customer turnout. Eat up plenty of screams and grow stronger. I'm looking forward to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぅ、
出だしは順調な客入りじゃねぇか。
たくさん悲鳴を食って成長しろよ。
期待してるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Wow, unexpected. You have quite the atmosphere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ、
意外。
けっこう雰囲気あるわね。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
But I wonder why there's no one at the reception...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
でも、
受付の人はいないのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Ah, another customer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
またお客人ですか……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, please come in. 
We will provide you with the finest hospitality at our establishment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようこそおいでくださいました。
当館では
極上のおもてなしを
提供させていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
But I do not recommend it, you know? 
The way of hospitality is quite unique.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですがおすすめはいたしませんよ？
もてなし方が一風変わっておりますので。

text_block_list.name: Female 3
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it seems someone is raising their voice in joy again. 
If you wish to follow that voice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
またどなたかよろこびの声を上げていらっしゃいますね。
あの声に続きたいというのであれば……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Please proceed following the light of guidance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうぞ、
導きの光に従いお進みください。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Whew... Somehow, the first day is over, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
なんとか初日が終わったね。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
This is the first time so many customers have come to visit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！
　こんなにお客さんが来てくれたの初めてだよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. I've been working almost non-stop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうッスね。
ほとんどひっきりなしに働いてたッス。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: It seems like kishi-san did a good job promoting it over there, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: そこは騎士さんがうまいこと宣伝してくれたみたいですね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I would be happy if you could say that to me.
text_block_list.orig_text: キミにそう言ってもらえるとうれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I'll respond to your efforts, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text: あんたのがんばりに応えるッス！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Kishi-san, I have been giving you various tasks to do, so this is your line, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんにはいろいろな仕事をやってもらっているので
それはこちらの台詞なんですけど……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Should I help you too, Miss Rei?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり私も
キミを手伝おうか？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Miss Rei~~?
text_block_list.orig_text: レイ様～～？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: It's just a joke. If we've come this far, we must fulfill our duty until the end. We can't afford to lose, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談だよ。
ここまで来たら最後まで役目を全うするさ。
負けていられない、
からね。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Onii-chan!
Thank you for bringing so many customers with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃん！
　たくさんのお客さん連れてきてくれて
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Kishi-san's absent-minded atmosphere may not be very intimidating, but it seems to have lured them into a false sense of security. It's a rare fine play, Kishi-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんのぼんやりした雰囲気があまり怖くないのかも、
っていい意味で油断を誘ってくれたみたいですね。
珍しくファインプレーです、
騎士さん。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: So you've gotten hooked on {0}'s vibe, and your first pairing with Victor. Thanks, pal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんの雰囲気と、
最初の
自分とビクターさんのコンビがうまいこと
ハマったってワケッスね。
感謝ッス。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: The business has just begun, so there are still plenty of areas for improvement. Let's tighten our focus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
営業は始まったばかりですし、
改善点はまだまだあります。
気を引き締めていきましょう。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Well, I've moved a few times in front of the customers, haven't I? It's surprisingly tough to stay still, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだなー
オレサマお客さんの前で何度か動いちまったしなー
動かないのって
案外キツイなー

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I also made a few mistakes in guiding you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレも何回か
案内の仕方間違えた。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, if you fail, you can just use it as a learning experience for the next time. In fact, being able to reflect on your mistakes is a remarkable form of growth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
失敗したら次に活かせばいいんです。
むしろ反省できるようになっただけすごい成長です。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's keep devouring screams more and more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だな！
　どんどん悲鳴食っていこうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: By the way, today's screams were delicious, weren't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
今日の悲鳴おいしかったよね？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: By the way... I have a feeling...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば……
そんな気がする……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Is it because it's the first day?
text_block_list.orig_text: 初日だからじゃねぇか？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Somehow,
it feels like it had a faint sweetness to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかなぁ？
　
なんか、ほんのり甘かった気がするんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I understand. 
It was sweeter than what I ate in the graveyard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、それは分かる。
墓場で食ったのより甘かった。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I wonder what it could be~
text_block_list.orig_text: なんなんだろうね～

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
We have no idea what you're talking about,
but please don't get too obsessed with eating screams, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちにはまったく分からない話ですけど、
悲鳴食べるのに夢中になったりしないでくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! It's the first time things are going well,
you know! I won't slack off! Let's do our best tomorrow too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいじょうぶ！
　初めてうまくいってるんだもん！
手は抜かないよ！
明日も一生懸命がんばろうね！

text_block_list.name: Ghosts
text_block_list.text: Ohhh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おー！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first day of the haunted house
came to a close without incident.
text_block_list.orig_text: こうしてお化け屋敷の初日は無事に幕を下ろした。
